overview: The Medford City Council Committee of the Whole met to discuss a long-standing public tree ordinance. The committee voted to refer the amended ordinance to the regular meeting with outstanding questions for administration officials.

items.title: Public Tree Ordinance (Paper 19-070)
items.summary: Referred the public tree ordinance to the regular meeting as amended, with additional questions directed to the Department of Public Works and KP Law regarding how canopy replacement penalties are calculated.
